title: Make snapshot and rollback validation trustworthy
description: Add snapshot integrity metadata and staged rollback so restore does not destroy the live site before validation succeeds.
action: In backend/services/version_service.py, compute a SHA-256 hash for each created snapshot archive and store it under SiteVersion.diff_summary["archive_sha256"]; during rollback_to_version(), download the archive, verify the stored SHA-256, validate tar member paths with Python tarfile before extraction, extract into a temporary staging directory, and only replace the live site root after extraction and validation succeed; remove the direct subprocess tar extraction path.

criteria: backend/services/version_service.py does not contain "subprocess.run(["tar", "-xzf", archive_path, "-C", str(root)], check=True)"
convergence.definition_of_done: Rollback verifies archive integrity and restores through a staged path before replacing the live site tree.

files.change: Store archive SHA-256 metadata, validate tar members, extract into staging, and replace the live site only after validation succeeds.
Add coverage for snapshot checksum metadata and staged rollback success/failure behavior.

implementation: Add a small SHA-256 helper in version_service and store the digest inside diff_summary["archive_sha256"] when create_snapshot() uploads the archive.
Replace subprocess tar extraction with Python tarfile member inspection and extraction into a temporary staging directory.
Only stop the site and swap the live root after archive checksum validation and staging extraction both succeed.
Add pytest coverage for successful rollback and checksum-validation failure without destructive live-root replacement.

success_metrics: Rollback failure does not destroy the live site before validation passes

reference.pattern: Version APIs already go through version_service and authenticated site access

rationale.chosen_approach: This strengthens the existing version_service seam instead of inventing a separate rollback subsystem.
decision_factors: SiteVersion.diff_summary can hold integrity metadata without a schema change
destructive live-root replacement is the main current trust gap
rationale.tradeoffs: Rollback code becomes slightly longer, but it becomes diagnosable and reversible.

risks: Be careful to clean up staging directories on both success and failure.
